high_level_description: The image depicts a modern, multi-level house constructed from shipping containers, situated in a wooded area. The structure is elevated on stilts, with large glass windows allowing ample natural light to enter the interior spaces. The containers are painted black, creating a sleek and contemporary look. The ground level features an open courtyard with a sandy or gravelly surface. There are several potted plants and small shrubs arranged around the perimeter of the courtyard, adding a touch of greenery to the scene.
